per_candidate.id: s2:ELVES-Dwarf. I. Satellite Systems of Eight Isolated Dwarf Galaxies in the Local

rationale: The papers 2412.14621, 2306.04674, 2303.10190, and 2504.02928 provide new insights into the internal structure and dynamics of dwarf galaxies in relation to dark matter models, contributing evidence relevant to the question about low-mass dark-matter halos and their implications.
